correctness.rationale: The LCF graph (18 vertices, 27 edges, cubic bipartite girth six) has 6 distance-four forbidden triples. At scale 2 the two same-side subcomplexes are each D_3*D_3*D_3 ~= wedge^8 S^2; all mixed edges are actual incidences; absence of four-cycles prevents a mixed 2+2 clique. The two cone-covered pieces U,V have intersection the original connected graph P and each collapses to a simply connected side complex. Since maps from P to U,V are null, the homotopy pushout gives wedge^8 S^2 vee wedge^8 S^2 vee suspension(P) = wedge^26 S^2, integrally. Scale 1 is P ~= wedge^10 S^1, scale 3 is the exact join of six discrete triples ~= wedge^64 S^5, and scale 4 is a simplex. Nonzero degrees appear only in separate successive stages, fixing integral and field barcodes. Independent reconstruction checked distances, q=3 affine-plane deletion graph isomorphism, all scale-1/2/3 face counts, exact U union V and intersection, and the full 225-face acyclic Morse matching with 99 matched pairs and 1 critical 0-cell + 26 critical 2-cells. Computation independently corroborates this finite graph proof; no bound extrapolation is used.
